app.title: AutoCulling - Motorsport Burst Photo Culling Tool

topbar.placeholder_dir: Select or paste photo directory path...
topbar.title_save: Safely save changes and ratings to XMP sidecars / image metadata

config.tip_top_n_desc: Maximum number of starred frames kept per burst group. Remaining frames are automatically rejected in descending score order.
config.tip_top_n_impact: Controls selection density and per-burst quota
config.tip_workers_desc: Number of multi-core parallel image decoding workers. Increasing this improves throughput but uses more CPU and RAM.
config.tip_p4_desc: Smart vehicle orientation filter. 'always' always rejects rear-view shots; 'auto' only activates if directory name contains F1/GP.
config.tip_p4_impact: Filters out unappealing rear chase shots
config.tip_recursive_desc: Recursively traverse all subdirectories under the selected folder to load photos.
config.tip_force_desc: Overwrite existing XMP/EXIF ratings. When off, manually scored photos are kept intact to save time.
config.tip_sharp_desc: High-frequency detail ratio cutoff. Frames below this threshold are immediately rejected as blurry or out-of-focus.
config.tip_sharp_impact: Absolute bottom line for image clarity
config.tip_w_sharp_desc: Score formula: Sharpness × Weight. Increasing this favors razor-sharp subject detail.
config.tip_w_sharp_impact: Relative weight of sharpness in overall score
config.tip_w_comp_desc: Score formula: Composition × Weight. Based on rule-of-thirds and subject centering/lead-room aesthetics.
config.tip_min_raw_desc: Minimum composite score threshold required for star rating. Photos below this score are rejected.
config.tip_min_raw_impact: Entry barrier for starring and rejection rate
config.tip_conf_desc: Confidence threshold for car/racecar detection. Higher values prevent false positives, lower values detect distant small objects.
config.tip_scale_desc: Downsampling resolution before inference and sharpness estimation. 0 means full resolution. Smaller is faster.
config.tip_scale_impact: Balances decoding speed and detail preservation
config.tip_rf_key_desc: Optional. Provide a key to use Roboflow cloud model; leave empty to use the fast local ONNX engine.
config.tip_autocrop_desc: Writes optimal 3:2 / 2:3 crop coordinates into XMP sidecars based on detected subject bounding box.
config.tip_dry_run_desc: Displays scores and statistics in UI without modifying any disk photo files or XMP metadata.
config.tip_rename_title: Rename based on EXIF capture time
config.tip_rename_desc: Renames photos to standard IMG_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_mmm format and synchronizes XMP sidecars.

dialog.dry_run_warn:
[Mode Notice]
Dry-Run mode is enabled.

Scores will be computed and displayed in the UI only. The system will NOT write, rename, or modify any photo files, XMP sidecars, or embedded metadata on disk.
dialog.rename_warn:
[File Modification Notice]
Capture time renaming is enabled.

Upon starting, file names on disk will be directly renamed to IMG_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_mmm format. Associated RAW, HEIF/JPG, and XMP sidecar files will be renamed in sync.
